cover.title: LaChanze
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: This was no ordinary moment in cabaret. This was storytelling, singing, acting, performing being presented at its highest vibration. It was an unforgettable moment in time for everyone present. That is the magic of LaChanze. BroadwayWorld

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Tony Award winner LaChanze—originator of the role of Celie in The Color Purple—possesses one of the most commanding and deeply felt voices on the American stage. An evening with LaChanze is an encounter with an artist at the fullest expression of her powers.
body: A Tony Award winner for originating the role of Celie in The Color Purple, LaChanze possesses one of the most commanding and deeply felt voices on the American stage. Her gift is rare: technical brilliance in complete service to the song, the truth of the music, and the electricity of genuine human feeling. An evening with LaChanze is an encounter with an artist at the fullest expression of her powers, one that audiences carry with them long after the last note rings out.
